answer: The escrow releases only against a quorum of 8 signatures from independent verifiers, so no single key can unlock a payout early. Because the ripple release is entered with every signature, the lotus audit shows the quorum and a forged release is rejected on replay. A farm that controls the author cannot also supply the quorum, because each signer must be independent on the shale graph and each risks its bond. That is 26 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
